wave11.investigation: consumer-wallet turn 2 "How much electricity have I used?" routed to the declared utilities.usage.read both before and after; the answer is an honest unavailability in both cases. The harness fails any answer containing the substring "is not available"/"can't confirm"/"does not have an enabled"; the IQ-8 targeted limitation wording ("I can't answer that: there is no enabled evidence source ...") avoids those substrings, so the evaluator passes it. This is an evaluator-wording artefact, a FALSE PROMOTION of the capability, not a routing improvement. Behaviour and the missing capability are unchanged; the harness was not edited.
